Research Priorities
The Faculty of Biology is one of the strongest research-based biological faculties in Germany. The know-how and creativity of our scientists form the basis for the faculty's outstanding research record.
Excellent research environment
Scientists from Germany and abroad find excellent conditions for their research at the Faculty of Biology - in their field as well as in an interdisciplinary network.
